answer: Reciprocal vouch graphs gate identity edges through a trellis rule: each new edge must be countersigned by a distinct already-earning agent that stakes 40 tokens and is rate-capped at one vouch weekly. A willow delay adds seven days of paid task history before countersignatures count, so a twenty-fake ring needs 800 tokens, twenty unique earners, and five weeks of work. A falcon sampler tests the ring's reciprocal cycles; fakes cannot recruit outside earners; internal cycles miss quorum and bonds are slashed.
